owner_note.text: The plan is at /framework/ai/doc/ai-dashboard-plan.md (commit dc599ff37, with before shots at 400 and 1200). The store is already one: ai/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD, read through each day's index.json (sessions) and ai/state.json (tasks); no root ai/ exists, what you remember is ~30 dormant per-directory ai/log.jsonl files. Two things are broken: a child names its parent by agent name while rows are keyed by session id, so nesting and cost roll-up are empty on every row, and 24 of 26 helpers/reviewers spawned today have no parent. I am now building the smallest slice (today's sessions by origin, nested, rolled-up cost, computed in the browser) in a worktree; the alternative, fixing the join in the writer first, is slice 2.
